name: Moelis & Co.
reason: Pure M&A/restructuring advisory boutique whose earnings follow capital-markets deal activity (EPS swung from 5.40 in 2021 to -0.20 in 2023, latest 0.55x 10y peak) with share count up 14%/yr; no forecastable compounding.

name: BankUnited, Inc.
reason: Rate- and CRE-credit-sensitive Florida/NY commercial bank with a relatively high-cost deposit base, ~10.6% 10y ROE and choppy EPS (4/10 years >=7% growth, -46% in 2018); ordinary bank with no specialness.

name: Sylvamo Corporation
reason: Uncoated freesheet paper and market pulp producer in secular volume decline with commodity-priced earnings (adj EPS fell from 7.42 to 3.54 in 2025, consensus FY1 -64%); cheap but not special.

name: Enovis Corporation
reason: Orthopedics roll-up built by acquisition (10y acquisitions 7.1x cumulative FCF, shares +3.2%/yr) with GAAP EBIT margin ~0% for four years, net debt/EBITDA 4.5x and adjusted EPS 145% above GAAP.

name: Jackson Financial Incorporation
reason: Variable-annuity writer whose GAAP EPS swings with hedging and market moves (64.23 in 2022 to -0.24 in 2025) and whose adjusted earnings depend on equity markets and rates; liability block too opaque to forecast.

name: Sally Beauty Holdings, Inc.
reason: Beauty-supply retailer with flat revenue over 10y (-0.4%/yr), EBIT margin down from 13.1% to 8.2%, net debt/EBITDA 3.5x and EPS growth reliant on buybacks; ex-growth and not special.

name: Seneca Foods Corporation
reason: Canned-vegetable processor with crop- and commodity-driven earnings, EPS at 1.0x its 10y max with margin in the 91st percentile after a run-up and 10y avg ROIC of only 5%; cyclical-peak earnings in an undifferentiated business.

name: Boot Barn Holdings, Inc.
reason: Category-leading western/work-wear retailer with a long new-store runway, growing exclusive brands, 26.7%/yr adj EPS CAGR over 10y, ~19% avg ROE and net debt/EBITDA 1.7x (mostly leases); main caveat is EPS at 1.0x 10y high with margin in the 82nd percentile, so fashion-cycle risk needs testing.

name: TowneBank
reason: Well-run Virginia community bank but EPS sits at 0.98x 10y peak on rate tailwinds, ROE averages just 8.7%, and growth has come with a share count rising 4.1%/yr through bank and insurance acquisitions.

name: Starwood Property Trust, Inc.
reason: Commercial mortgage REIT with net debt/EBITDA ~14x, CRE credit exposure and distributable EPS shrinking 2.6%/yr over 10y while shares rose 4.1%/yr; spread- and credit-cycle earnings.

name: KKR & Co Inc
reason: Strong alternative-asset franchise, but earnings mix fee income with carry, principal investments and the Global Atlantic insurance balance sheet (EBIT margin swung from 113% to -21%, net debt/EBITDA 6.4x), so they depend on capital markets and cannot be forecast with confidence.

name: HF Sinclair Corporation
reason: Petroleum refiner whose earnings are set by crack spreads (EPS ranged from -0.87 to 14.73 over 10y, 10y CAGR 0.8%); commodity earnings that cannot be forecast.

name: Ares Capital Corporation
reason: Best-in-class BDC, but its income depends on credit spreads and base rates; per-share EPS grew only 2.7%/yr over 10y because shares rose 8.3%/yr, and consensus sees EPS declining, so there is no route to 7% growth.

name: Northern Oil and Gas, Inc.
reason: Non-operated Williston E&P with oil-price-driven earnings, share count up 32%/yr from acquisition-funded growth and adjusted EPS 254% above GAAP; commodity business.

name: Prospect Capital Corporation
reason: Lower-quality BDC with net investment income per share falling 4.2%/yr over 10y, consensus FY1 -44%, heavy GAAP losses versus adjusted (387% gap) and 6.5x leverage.

name: Renasant Corporation
reason: Southeastern community bank with 10y EPS CAGR of 0.0% while shares grew 9.2%/yr through serial mergers (including the 2025 The First deal), ROE ~7%; growth comes from acquisitions, not the core business.

name: Arbor Realty Trust Inc
reason: Multifamily bridge-lending mortgage REIT under credit stress (EPS -38.5% in 2025, 0.48x 10y peak), net debt/EBITDA ~11x and shares up 15%/yr; credit-cycle dependent.

name: Sensata Technologies Holding PLC
reason: Auto-heavy sensor maker with adj EPS up just 2.2%/yr over 10y, acquisitions at 0.44x FCF, net debt/EBITDA 3.0x, ICE-to-EV content uncertainty and GAAP EPS far below adjusted (484% gap).

name: MidCap Financial Investment Corporation
reason: Externally managed senior-loan BDC with NII per share down 4.8%/yr over 10y, ~4% avg ROE, 9.6x net debt/EBITDA and consensus EPS declining; spread-dependent with no growth.

name: RingCentral, Inc.
reason: Cloud PBX/UCaaS vendor facing commoditization from Microsoft Teams/Zoom and AI disintermediation, with revenue growth slowing, GAAP EBIT margin only 5.5% (at its 10y high) and adjusted EPS ~8x GAAP because of heavy stock compensation.
